en.title: Denmark wants to ban prosecutors from wearing headscarves in court
en.summary: Danish Justice Minister Nicolai Wammen wants to ban prosecutors from wearing religious headwear in court. New guidelines are to be introduced to ensure that prosecutors, according to the minister, appear objective and politically and religiously neutral in the courtroom.

en.title: New twist in tax dispute – venture capital bosses required to pay 800 million

Nu behöver de rättigheterna omsättas i handling, skriver Carolina Klüft verksamhetschef Generation Pep.

en.title: Carolina Klüft: Children's health cannot wait
en.summary: Government formation may drag on. Childhood does not. The Convention on the Rights of the Child establishes children's right to security, development and participation, and that the best interests of the child shall be the primary consideration. Now those rights need to be put into action, writes Carolina Klüft, head of operations at Generation Pep.
